paragraphs.text: Ghed was one of the twelve Southern City-States during the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria .

Ghed was a city on the coast, three days' travel southwest of Alsoor. Jodah came to the city fleeing the Church of Tal , and became trapped there when the city was locked down by a plague. He peddled healing wares but was discovered by Sima and the Church when an Alabaster Potion he had made healed its recipients. To hide from the church, Jodah joined the army of Ghed in its war against Alsoor . This enabled him to leave the city and placed him in the middle of the Battle of Pitdown .
It is unknown what ultimately happened to Ghed, but its territory would later be a part of Kjeldor during the Ice Age . After the Thaw , it would be included in the terrain of New Argive .
